title: Model a Learner
prompt:
Model real data:

1. Create `learner` — an object with `name` (string), `streak` (number), and `skills` (an array of at least two skill names).
2. Write `isOnFire(person)` that returns true when `streak` is 7 or more.
3. Create `cohort` — an array of two learner objects (reuse the same shape). Log the name of the second one.

tests.name: learner has the right shape
isOnFire reads the property
tests.hint: (person) => person.streak >= 7 — read the property off the parameter.

tests.name: cohort is an array of learners, second name logged
tests.hint: console.log(cohort[1].name); — index into the array, then the property.
